data.text: Celebrations at The VIDYA School nurture social unity, creative expression, national pride, and joyous community fellowship.

items.title: Vidya Tech Fest
items.description: Our premier STEM innovation fest bringing together students from Delhi NCR for hackathons, science project exhibits, and robotics competitions.

items.title: Vidya Lit Fest & Cultural Day
items.description: Annual literary festival featuring elocution, poetry recitation, theatrical drama, storytelling, and book fairs.

items.title: National Holiday Celebrations
items.description: Unfurling the tricolor on Independence Day and Republic Day with patriotic anthems, cultural parades, and student speeches.

items.title: Diwali & Christmas Celebrations
items.description: Lighting diyas, sharing sweets, singing Christmas carols, and hosting festive meals with mentors and supporters.
